source.author: ov
source.text: liceat periturae viribus ignis igne perire tuo clademque auctore levare.
source.text_original: liceat periturae viribus ignis / igne perire tuo clademque auctore levare.
source.text_english: May it be permitted for one doomed to die to perish by your fire’s power through fire, and, by your aid, to lessen the disaster.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: imbrem et tenebras saevumque tridentem iam iam ego et inviti torsissem coniugis ignem.
reuse.text_original: imbrem et tenebras saevumque tridentem / iam iam ego et inviti torsissem coniugis ignem.
reuse.text_english: I myself would already now have hurled rain and darkness and the savage trident, and my wife’s fire, though unwillingly.
